<details>
<summary>繁體中文頁面</summary>

這是[更好的配方書](https://modrinth.com/mod/brb)的分支，旨在移植到更高版本或擴展功能。  

- 更好的配方書模組改進了原版的配方書（與JEI的概念相似），使其更加方便易用。
- 即使你不喜歡配方書也可以安裝此模組，因為它提供了禁用配方書入口的功能。
- 前往他們的頁面了解核心功能。

### 擴展功能

1. 在生存模式物品欄顯示所有已解鎖配方。（可配置）
2. 全新的配方狀態——缺少部分材料的配方：例如物品欄擁有某個配方的材料但無法合成，將以特殊紋理標記（可配置）
3. 全新的配方排序模式：將可合成配方始終置頂顯示，不再通過按鈕切換顯示模式（可配置）
4. 顯示來源模組名稱。（可配置）  
   可透過資源包翻譯模組名稱，鍵名為 `"jade.modName.<namespace>"`

5. 配方書內的物品能夠透過 REI/JEI 查看配方及用途。
6. 可以透過配置介面隱藏 REI/JEI 的介面（不影響查詢合成/用途功能）。（可配置）
   對喜歡簡潔介面但又需要某些工具的玩家很合適。

7. 完整複刻 REI 的高級搜尋功能（例如 ModID、Tag 搜尋）。
8. 全新的配方分類：將創造模式物品欄的分類應用到配方書（Recipe Book is Pain 的分支）。（可配置）
   如果不喜歡上下側標籤頁也可以將其關閉，只顯示左側標籤頁。

9. 針對配方書的開啟速度進行史詩級優化。（在 ATM10 V7.0 做到秒開）

### 如何正確安裝？

 - 僅需要客戶端部署即可實現全部功能。
 - 需要與 Cloth Config API 同時部署。（2.1.4b 及以前的版本（26.2 除外）需要再部署 Architectury API）

### 受支援的 Minecraft 版本及模組載入器

| | Fabric | NeoForge |
|---|---|---|
| 26.2 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 26.1.2 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.11 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.1 | ✅ | ✅ |

### 支援的語言

| 語言 |
|---|
| en_us |
| zh_cn |
| zh_tw |
| ja_jp |
| ru_ru |
| pl_pl |
| tr_tr |
---
如果有關於本專案的建議（雖然不一定會實現）和 Bug，歡迎前往 [GitHub](https://github.com/Avalonia-0/Better-Recipe-Book-Extended-) 提交 Issue。  
可以在 QQ 群（1015199675）和 [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1516632172985847828/1516632173720113306) 交流技術問題！

</details>


<details>
<summary>English page</summary>

This is a fork of [Better Recipe Book](https://modrinth.com/mod/brb), aimed at porting to newer Minecraft versions or extending functionality.

- Better Recipe Book improves the vanilla recipe book (similar in concept to JEI), making it more convenient and user-friendly.
- Even if you do not like the recipe book, you can still install this mod because it provides a feature to disable the recipe book entry.
- Visit their page to learn about the core features.

### Extended Features

1. Show all unlocked recipes in the survival inventory. (configurable)
2. New recipe status — recipes missing some ingredients: for example, if your inventory contains some ingredients for a recipe but it cannot yet be crafted, it will be marked with a special texture. (configurable)
3. New recipe sorting mode: craftable recipes are always pinned to the top, without switching display modes through a button. (configurable)
4. Display the source mod name. (configurable)  
   Mod names can be translated via resource packs using the key `"jade.modName.<namespace>"`

5. Items inside the recipe book can be viewed in REI/JEI for recipes and usages.
6. Hide the REI/JEI interface via the config screen without affecting recipe/usage lookup functionality. (configurable)
   Ideal for players who prefer a clean UI but still need certain tools.

7. Fully replicate REI's advanced search functionality, such as ModID and Tag search.
8. New recipe categories: apply creative mode inventory categories to the recipe book. (A fork of Recipe Book is Pain.) (configurable)
   If you do not like the top/bottom tabs, you can also turn them off and show only the left-side tabs.  

9. Epic optimization for recipe book opening speed. (Instant opening achieved in ATM10 V7.0)

### How to Install?

 - Client-side installation is enough to enable all features.
 - Requires Cloth Config API to be installed alongside it. (Versions 2.1.4b and earlier, except 26.2, also require Architectury API.)

### Supported Minecraft Versions and Mod Loaders

| | Fabric | NeoForge |
|---|---|---|
| 26.2 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 26.1.2 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.11 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.1 | ✅ | ✅ |

### Supported Languages

| Language |
|---|
| en_us |
| zh_cn |
| zh_tw |
| ja_jp |
| ru_ru |
| pl_pl |
| tr_tr |
---
If you have any suggestions (though they may not necessarily be implemented) or bugs regarding this project, feel free to submit an Issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/Avalonia-0/Better-Recipe-Book-Extended-).  
You can discuss technical issues in the QQ group (1015199675) or on [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1516632172985847828/1516632173720113306)!
</details>
